claim_boundary: This is a one-backbone, one-trainable-scalar development sufficiency test. It can establish a causal functional decomposition on seed 2101 but cannot establish population replication, a biological memory system, unique tensor-product coding, or end-to-end co-adaptation. A valid failure closes this minimal fixed-address local-trace candidate, not every possible persistent local mechanism and not the confirmed P_T global mechanism.

registered_rules.H_greater_A_rescue: The paired retained-subject bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 H>A direct correctness exceeds zero, and the dual-intact H>A direct-correctness bootstrap upper bound is at least zero.
registered_rules.aggregate_local_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
registered_rules.global_branch_preservation: Original-v1/local-off exactly reproduces v1, passes every qualification_v2 intervention and query-order rule, retains positive query-binding contrasts, and retains an expected-rank-minus-MAP bootstrap lower bound above zero.
registered_rules.global_off_remote_collapse: The participant-bootstrap upper bound for global-P-off/local-intact remote absolute influence minus 0.25 times original-v1 remote absolute influence is below zero.
registered_rules.global_reassembly_preservation: Dual-intact remote absolute and third-party relational estimands each have bootstrap lower bounds above zero and point estimates at least 80 percent of original-v1.
registered_rules.learned_accuracy_rescue: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus original-v1 learned accuracy exceeds zero.
registered_rules.local_direct_specificity: For the natural local branch, the participant-bootstrap lower bound of mean absolute direct influence minus three times mean absolute disjoint remote influence exceeds zero.
registered_rules.local_only_direct_memory: Under global-P-off/local-intact, the participant-bootstrap lower bound for learned accuracy exceeds 0.55, the upper bound for nonlearned accuracy is at most 0.60, and the paired lower bound for learned minus nonlearned accuracy exceeds 0.10.
registered_rules.nonlearned_preservation: Dual-intact nonlearned accuracy is at least 0.70 and its paired participant-bootstrap lower bound relative to original-v1 is no smaller than -0.02.
registered_rules.query_address_specificity: The paired participant-bootstrap lower bound for dual-intact minus local-query-key-shuffle retained-relation mean direct correctness exceeds zero.
